name: Claire: The Exchange Student
source:
Kendra is a member of the cultural exchange program and is in charge of picking up a new student from France named Claire. But now Kendra is faced with the choice of staying with her steady boyfriend, David, or exploring a new side that has been awakened by Claire. 

[From [url=http://lessonofpassion.wikia.com/wiki/Claire:_The_Exchange_Student]Lesson of Passion Wikia[/url]]
translation:
Kendra是文化交流项目成员，负责接待来自法国的新生Claire。但如今，她必须在与稳定交往的男友David继续相处，和探索Claire唤醒的全新自我之间做出选择。

（来源：[url=http://lessonofpassion.wikia.com/wiki/Claire:_The_Exchange_Student]Lesson of Passion维基[/url]）
